Pour in heavy cream and mix until smooth, creamy, and slightly thickened (that rich orange color 🔥). Add noodles and toss until fully coated. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top and let it melt into the sauce. Add dumplings and sausages on top. Cover and let everything heat through. things that might annoy you in korea 2. cafes In Korea, cafes often open later than you’d expect. Some cafes even open around lunchtime. The reason is that people in Korea don’t really eat breakfast at cafes. Cafes in Korea are usually more like places to talk with friends, go on dates, study, or get some work done. So unless a cafe is on a busy commuter route, many cafes don’t open that early. But instead, many of them stay open late. So if you want to go to a cafe in Korea in the morning, make sure to check the opening hours first. Useful phrases: 몇 시에 열어요? myeot si-e yeo-reo-yo? 🍆 Stop frying your eggplant. These 3 homemade eggplant salads are easy to make, packed with flavor, and not one requires frying. Save this reel and let me know which one you’re making first👇 OVEN BAKED EGGPLANT DIP🍆🍅🧅🧄 Ingredients: • 1 large eggplant or 2 small eggplants, cut into large cubes • 1 onion, chopped • 1 large tomato, chopped • 2 jalapeños or 5 serrano chilies • 1 red pepper, chopped • Handful of garlic cloves, peeled Sauce: • ½ cup olive oil • ¼ cup tomato paste • ¼ cup pomegranate molasses • ¼ cup date molasses • 1 tbsp salt • 1 tbsp paprika Place all vegetables in an oven-safe dish. Mix sauce ingredients separately and pour over vegetables. Toss well. Cover and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes. Uncover, mix, and bake an additional 30 minutes. EGGPLANT VEGETABLE SALAD🍆🍅🥒🧄 Ingredients: • 1 large eggplant • 2 firm tomatoes, finely diced • 4 Persian cucumbers, finely diced • ⅓ cup olive oil • Juice of 2 lemons • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1-2 tsp salt Slice eggplant lengthwise and roast face down on a grill until soft, about 15-18 minutes total. Alternatively, roast at 425°F for about 45 minutes. Remove the flesh, roughly chop, and combine with tomatoes, cucumbers, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and salt. EGGPLANT MUSHROOM SALAD🍆🍄‍🟫🌿🧄 Ingredients: • 1 large eggplant, cubed • 4-5 mushrooms, sliced • 1 bunch cilantro or parsley, chopped • 3-4 garlic cloves, minced • ⅓ cup olive oil • Juice of 1 lemon • ¼ cup vinegar • 1-2 tsp salt Place eggplant on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Spray generously with oil and season with salt. Bake at 425°F for about 45 minutes. Cool and combine with mushrooms, herbs, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, and salt. Toss well and serve. #sivanskitchen #eggplant #salad #homemade #EasyRecipe
